title: Never Outshine the Master
summary: Outshining your master is a fatal mistake. You must strategically act less capable than you are, look feeble, ask questions, and flatter them discreetly to keep them secure. Only when the master's power is clearly fading should you seize the opportunity to outshine them and let nature take its course.
example: The Galileo example of adapting to strategy to secure promotion and shine the master's image
reversal: When it is certain that the master's power is fading, you must plant or outshine your master and let nature take its course.
